about_page.title: About
about_page.description:
Road Companion is an interactive and automated application designed to improve road safety in Algeria. With one of the highest accident rates in North Africa, this application addresses challenges related to the lack of awareness of traffic rules, insufficient incident reporting, and limited access to real-time roadside assistance.

Road Companion helps drivers by providing smart tools for safer and more responsible driving.
